title: Determine Tipper/Station Status From Operator Station Stacklights
summary: Use the operator station stacklight color/flash/horn pattern to identify the current status of the corresponding tipper and station, including RMS error, E-stop, tipping state, and bagout/surepost indications.
when_to_use: When you need to determine the current documented status of a tipper/station from the operator station stacklights (solid vs flashing colors, and horn alarm pattern when present).
not_for: Do not use this procedure to clear or reset E-stop or RMS error conditions.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Physically observe the operator station stacklights and interpret the solid/flashing color (and horn alarm pattern when present) into the documented tipper/station status.
safety_notes: If the observed stacklight pattern indicates E-stop activated (Solid Red), escalate immediately and do not attempt to clear remotely from this procedure.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the operator station stacklights
Ability to observe stacklight color(s), solid vs flashing, and horn alarm pattern (long vs intermittent) when present

access_required: Physical access to the operator station stacklights

visual_references.description: Stacklight state meanings (solid/flashing colors and RMS error/fault/AGV presence) used to interpret station status.

Operator station HMI Manual Control screen showing LAMP TEST behavior (audible alarm and stacklight flashing red) and tipper disable/fault reset controls for context while interpreting stacklight signals.
HMI context for Surepost tote indication (stacklight flashes white) and operator station controls (Surepost LEFT/RIGHT).

steps.title: Go to the affected operator station
steps.purpose: Ensure you are observing the correct stacklights for the tipper/station in question.
steps.instruction: Walk to the operator station for the affected tipper/station and position yourself so you can clearly see both stacklights.
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify both stacklights at the operator station for the affected tipper/station.
steps.healthy_condition: Both stacklights are visible and you can distinguish solid vs flashing behavior.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot clearly see one or both stacklights (blocked view, distance, or unclear flashing).

actions.label: Visually confirm stacklight visibility
actions.exact_action: Observe both stacklights and note whether each is solid or flashing, and the displayed color(s).

steps.title: Observe both stacklights and record solid vs flashing colors
steps.purpose: Capture the observable stacklight pattern that maps to the documented tipper/station status.
steps.instruction: Observe both stacklights and note whether each is solid or flashing, and the displayed color(s).
steps.expected_result: You have identified each stacklight’s state (solid/flashing) and color(s).
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklight colors and flashing behavior are unambiguous (e.g., solid blue vs flashing green, etc.).
steps.failure_condition: The stacklight pattern is unclear (e.g., intermittent visibility) or does not allow confident identification of solid vs flashing and color(s).

actions.label: Note stacklight state and color(s)
actions.exact_action: Observe both stacklights and note whether each is solid or flashing, and the displayed color(s).

steps.title: If horn alarm pattern is indicated, determine long vs intermittent horn during flashing
steps.purpose: Some documented stacklight patterns include horn alarm timing; capturing it improves status mapping accuracy.
steps.instruction: If the source indicates a horn alarm pattern for the flashing state you are seeing, also observe whether there is a long horn alarm or intermittent horn alarm during the flashing pattern.
steps.expected_result: You have determined whether the horn alarm is long or intermittent during the flashing pattern.
steps.healthy_condition: Horn alarm timing is clearly distinguishable as long vs intermittent while the stacklight is flashing.
steps.failure_condition: Horn alarm timing cannot be distinguished (e.g., noise/unclear audio).

actions.label: Determine horn alarm timing
actions.exact_action: Observe whether there is a long horn alarm or intermittent horn alarm during the flashing pattern.

steps.title: Match the observed stacklight pattern to the documented tipper/station status meanings
steps.purpose: Convert the observed solid/flashing color (and horn timing when applicable) into the documented status.
steps.instruction: Match the observed pattern to the documented meanings for tipper/station status, including RMS error, E-stop, tipping state, and surepost/bagout indications.
steps.expected_result: You can map the observed stacklight solid/flashing color combination (and horn timing when present) to one documented status.
steps.healthy_condition: The observed pattern matches one of the documented combinations (examples include Solid Blue, Solid Green, Solid Red, Solid White, Solid Red+Yellow+Green, Flashing Blue, Flashing Green, Flashing Red, Flashing White, Flashing Yellow, and horn-timed combinations).
steps.failure_condition: The observed stacklight pattern does not match any documented combination.

actions.label: Map stacklight pattern to documented status
actions.exact_action: Match the observed pattern to the documented meanings: Solid Blue (Tipper paused), Solid Green (Tipping in process), Solid Red (Estop activated), Solid White (AGV present post-tipping), Solid Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error), Flashing Blue (Tipper disabled), Flashing Green (Tipper starved), Flashing Red (Tipper faulted), Flashing White (SurePost tote being sent), Flashing Yellow (AGV present pre-tipping), Flashing Green+Yellow+Green with long horn alarm (Sort starting), Flashing White with intermittent horn alarm (Bagout complete).

stop_or_escalate_if: Observed stacklight pattern does not match any documented combination

steps.title: Stop and escalate for E-stop activated or RMS error
steps.purpose: Ensure critical conditions are handled appropriately and not cleared via this interpretation procedure.
steps.instruction: If the mapped status indicates E-stop activated (Solid Red) or RMS error (Solid Red+Yellow+Green), stop and escalate immediately.
steps.expected_result: You have identified whether the mapped status is Solid Red (E-stop activated) or Solid Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error) and escalated accordingly.
steps.healthy_condition: Mapped status is not Solid Red (E-stop activated) and not Solid Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error).
steps.failure_condition: Mapped status is Solid Red (E-stop activated) or Solid Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error) and escalation is not initiated.

actions.label: Escalate critical condition
actions.exact_action: Stop and escalate if the observed stacklight pattern indicates Estop activated (Solid Red) or RMS error (Solid Red+Yellow+Green).

stop_or_escalate_if: Solid Red indicates Estop is activated
Solid Red+Yellow+Green indicates an RMS error

success_criteria: Operator can map the observed stacklight solid/flashing color combination (and horn timing when present) to a documented tipper/station status.
Operator escalates immediately when the mapped status indicates Solid Red (E-stop activated) or Solid Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error).
healthy_conditions: Stacklight pattern matches a documented combination and indicates a non-critical state (i.e., not Solid Red or Solid Red+Yellow+Green).
failure_conditions: Observed stacklight pattern does not match any documented combination.
Solid Red (E-stop activated) or Solid Red+Yellow+Green (RMS error) is present and escalation is not initiated.
escalation_guidance: If Solid Red indicates Estop is activated: escalate immediately; do not attempt to clear remotely from this procedure.
If Solid Red+Yellow+Green indicates an RMS error: escalate for further diagnostics.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Stacklight labeled states (Solid Red, Solid Green, Red/Yellow/Green, Flashing Red, Flashing Yellow for 15 seconds) to support interpretation of station status signals.
LAMP TEST button behavior (audible alarm and stacklight flashing red) and tipper disable behavior (stacklight illuminates solid blue) as contextual confirmation of stacklight signaling behavior.
Surepost tote indication: stacklight will flash white to let the operator know a Surepost tote is being delivered to the tipper.
